content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Clarksville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP® requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of experience. Verify your background meets PMI's education and professional requirements before enrolling in formal training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® course. Attend all sessions synchronously from anywhere, interact with active certified practitioners, and master the PMBOK® Guide framework. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement for exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35-hour course, submit your PMP® application directly to PMI, detailing your project-management experience. Pay the associated exam fee and await PMI's approval. This step formally registers you to sit for the PMP® examination.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review key concepts and practice questions. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE testing center when ready. You'll complete a comprehensive, computer-delivered assessment of your project-management knowledge and competency.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) across PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP® active. Engage in training, volunteering, or formal education aligned with the Talent Triangle to stay current and maintain your competitive edge in Clarksville's job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
